proof.text: Put G = O_X[0]. Its only nonzero term is quasi-coherent, and isFlatOver_of_isInvertible in the source Cohomology.DirectImage.Basic proves its relative flatness using Flat f. The zero terms are free on the empty set and have zero section modules, hence are quasi-coherent and flat. Properness supplies QuasiCompact f and QuasiSeparated f.

Apply nonempty_coordinates of [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition] to the identity of derivedPullback(g_X)(E), obtaining a K-flat representative P, Q(P) ≅ E, and invertibility of the canonical counit at P. This is a local existential elimination in a theorem proof; no definition chooses arbitrary data. Set H = Tot(P tensor G). The chain right unitor gives H ≅ P. The recorded derived monoidal construction [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], with upstream singleFunctorObjUnitIso, identifies Q(G) with the derived tensor unit. Combine these identifications to construct alpha : E tensor Q(G) ≅ Q(H).

Apply [lem-pc-rf-base-change-complex] to E, G, P and alpha. Naturality of the canonical counit along the homotopy image of H ≅ P proves it invertible at H. Cancel the invertible functor image of alpha and the direct image of this counit to obtain invertibility of the canonical beta at Q(H).

Prove naturality of [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] explicitly: form the natural transformation from the pullback composition comparisons of [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], square equality transport and adjunction counit; take its adjunction mate. The Hom-equivalence naturality-square lemma proves beta natural in E. Apply this equality to Q(H) ≅ Q(P) ≅ E and cancel the two functor images of that isomorphism. This gives exactly the requested IsIso beta_E.

title: Derived base change for proper flat finite-presentation morphisms
statement: Let Y and Y' be quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], f:X→Y proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation, and g:Y'→Y arbitrary. Put X'=X×_Y Y' [def-pc-fibre-product]. Use the shared quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and their canonical derived base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. For every E in D_QCoh(X), the canonical map Lg* Rf* E → Rf'* Lg_X* E is an isomorphism. No right adjoint or right-adjoint base-change assertion is involved.

lean.statement:
theorem proper_flat_rightAdjoint_baseChange_hβ
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y']
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] :
    ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
        IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
          pullback.condition E.obj)
